_readme: Colour code: [[r:...]] RED = best guess, not yet confirmed by owner. [[c:...]] CYAN = new idea suggested by Claude. Plain = confirmed.
name: Possible Manor House
photo_caption: A stone building that may be the old Manor House

layers.essential_history: [[r:This stone building, with an inscription above the doorway, is thought to be the old Manor House, though that is not yet confirmed. The village board says the Manor House was built by the Elmes family in the 16th or early 17th century, replacing an older manor belonging to Sir George Kirkham.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[r:Deeper history for this stop is still to be written.]]
layers.mystery: [[r:Journal page: the order was last seen being carried towards the dispatch room at the big house. Everyone at the house says they never touched it. Somebody is not telling the whole story.]]

puzzle_note: [[c:No puzzle here yet. Suggested: an observation question about the doorway inscription, once it can be read from the photo.]]
directions_to_next: [[r:Walk on a short way, about 100 metres, towards Chapel Street. The former Wesleyan chapel is a red-brick building with a round window.]]
private_note: This is a private home. Look from the road only.
notes: Do not confuse this with Eaglethorpe House, which is elsewhere on the route.
